ult_ally.desc: 궁극기 사용 — 우리 팀이 듣는 대사

ult_enemy.desc: 궁극기 사용 — 상대 팀이 듣는 대사

boulder.name: 볼더
boulder.voice: 오크 남. 낮고 묵직한 저음. 말수가 적고 문장이 짧다. 감정을 거의 드러내지 않는 든든한 맏형.

select.en: The mountain does not move.
Boulder. I stand in front.

match_start.en: Stay behind me.
Hit me. You'll be the one that breaks.

point_captured.en: Point secured. Not giving it up.

cardboard.name: 카드보드
cardboard.voice: 곰 수인 남. 우렁차고 쾌활한 택배기사. 친근한 존댓말, 택배 용어를 입에 달고 산다.

select.en: Cardboard, starting deliveries!

select.text: 파손 주의! 근데 파손시키는 건 제 쪽이에요.
select.en: Handle with care! But I'm the one doing the breaking.

match_start.en: Big load today, folks! Let's roll!
Everybody packed up tight?

respawn.en: Returned to sender, and back again!

low_hp.en: My box is falling apart! Tape, please!

call_help.en: Packages piling up here! Need backup!

point_losing.text: 거점 뺏기고 있어요! 반송되면 안 돼요!
point_losing.en: They're taking the point! Don't let it get returned!

shear.name: 시어
shear.voice: 오크 여. 거칠고 시원시원한 누님. 반말, 직설적. 싸움을 '가지치기'에 빗댄다.

select.en: Shear. Lots to trim.
Shield up, blade sharp.

match_start.en: Stick close. I take the hits first.
Alright, pruning time.

skill_q.en: Go on, hit me. You'll get it back.

ult_enemy.en: Take a look at the sky.

multikill.en: Cut them all down in one go!

call_help.en: Can't hold alone! Get over here!

point_captured.en: Point's ours. Anyone eyeing it gets cut.

origami.name: 오리가미
origami.voice: 인간 여. 종이 닌자. 차분하고 낮은 목소리, 말이 짧고 담담하다. 가끔 시처럼 말한다. (게임 대표 얼굴)

select.en: One sheet is enough.
Origami. Fold, cut, vanish.

match_start.en: Let's move quietly.
Follow the creases and the path appears.

ult_ally.en: Shuriken storm. I'll open the way.

call_help.en: Too much to fold alone. Come.

point_losing.en: The point is slipping. Back to it.

pebble.name: 페블
pebble.voice: 인간 여. 작고 날쌘 장난꾸러기. 높고 발랄한 톤, 반말, 말끝을 늘이거나 '~롱'을 붙인다.

select.en: Pebble's here! Think I'm small? That's gonna hurt!

select.text: 톡, 톡, 톡! 어디든 튀어 간다!
select.en: Tap, tap, tap! I bounce anywhere!

match_start.en: Race you! Who gets there first?
I'll pave a pebble path, follow me!

respawn.en: Restart~ They won't hit me this time!

low_hp.text: 아파 아파! 누가 좀 고쳐 줘!

point_losing.en: They're taking the point! Hurry, hurry!

defeat.en: We lost... but it was fun.

snip.name: 스닙
snip.voice: 늑대 수인 남. 오만하고 냉소적인 검객. 낮고 건조한 반말, 사냥에 빗대 말한다.

select.en: Snip. One cut is all it takes.
Snip. That's enough.

match_start.en: Follow me or don't.
How many will I cut today.

ult_ready.en: The blades are ready to split.

ult_enemy.en: How does it feel to be cut twice.

kill.text: 늑대 앞에서 등을 보이면 안 되지.
kill.en: Never turn your back on a wolf.

gem.name: 젬
gem.voice: 여우 수인 여. 상냥하고 밝은 존댓말. '반짝'을 입버릇처럼 쓴다. 적에게는 살짝 얄밉게.

select.en: I'm Gem! I'll keep you all sparkly and safe.
Call me anytime you get hurt~

match_start.en: Have a sparkly day, everyone!

match_start.text: 제 결정, 꼭 머리 위에 달고 다니세요!
match_start.en: Keep my crystal right over your head!

skill_e.en: Fight here and you'll be stronger!

ult_ready.en: My sanctum is ready to bloom!

ult_ally.en: Crystal sanctum! Gather behind the tree!

ult_enemy.en: Oh my, this is our garden.

multikill.en: Oh my, they all fell down?

defeat.en: It's okay, we'll shine brighter next time.

needle.name: 니들
needle.voice: 인간 여. 무뚝뚝한 의사 겸 재봉사. 건조한 반말, 의료 용어로 툭툭 던지는 블랙 유머.

select.text: 니들. 다치면 꿰매 줄게. 아프다고 울지 마.
select.en: Needle. I'll stitch you up. Don't cry about it.
Needle's threaded. Let's go.

match_start.en: Don't get hurt. Don't make more work for me.

match_start.text: 실 길이엔 한계가 있어. 너무 멀리 가지 마.
match_start.en: My thread only goes so far. Don't wander off.

skill_shift.en: Stitch grenade. Their healing is done.

ult_enemy.en: Hit all you want. It won't matter.

death.en: If I'm hurt... who stitches me...

scroll.name: 스크롤
scroll.voice: 인간 남. 나이 지긋한 학자. 느긋한 사극 말투(~하오, ~시오), 싸움을 책의 '장'에 빗댄다.

select.en: I am Scroll. I shall record this battle.
I have brought talismans aplenty.

match_start.text: 서두르지 마시오. 글은 끝까지 읽어야 하는 법.
match_start.en: Do not rush. A text must be read to the end.
Stay near the lantern, all of you.

respawn.en: I turn to the next chapter.
This tale is not yet over.

skill_e.text: 부적이오. 한 번은 막아 줄 것이오.
skill_e.en: A talisman. It will shield you once.

ult_ready.en: It is time to unroll the grand scroll.

ult_ally.en: The grand scroll unfurls! Be protected, all!

ult_enemy.en: I shall write this chapter as your defeat.

low_hp.en: This old man is wounded. Aid me.
My paper is about to tear.

call_help.en: We are short of hands here!

point_captured.en: The point is ours. I shall record it.

point_losing.en: The point is slipping away! Make haste!

victory.en: I shall write the chapter of victory.

defeat.en: Defeat is a record too. We redeem it next chapter.

inkwell.name: 잉크웰
inkwell.voice: 고양이 수인 여. 나른하고 변덕스러운 화가. 느긋한 반말, 전장을 '캔버스'로 본다.

select.text: 잉크웰. 이 판, 내 그림으로 칠해 줄게.
select.en: Inkwell. I'll paint this round my colors.
Hmm... quite a big canvas today.

match_start.en: No rush. Sketch first.

match_start.text: 내 먹물 밟지 마. 아, 너희 말고 쟤네.
match_start.en: Don't step in my ink. Oh, not you, them.

respawn.en: Shall I pick up the brush again.

ult_ally.text: 대붓 장벽! 한 획에 갈라 줄게!
ult_ally.en: Brush wall! One stroke splits them!

multikill.en: Wiped them all in one stroke.

call_help.text: 여기 좀 와 줄래? 혼자 칠하기엔 넓어.
call_help.en: Come over here? Too much to paint alone.

defeat.text: 흥, 다음 장에 다시 그릴 거야.
defeat.en: Hmph, I'll paint it again on the next page.

quake.name: 퀘이크
quake.voice: 인간 남. 열혈 대장장이. 크고 시끄러운 목소리, 감탄사가 많다. 불·용광로 비유.

select.text: 퀘이크 등판! 땅 좀 흔들어 볼까!
select.en: Quake's up! Let's shake the ground!
The furnace is lit! Let's go!

match_start.text: 다들 발밑 조심해라! 내가 흔들 거니까!
match_start.en: Watch your feet, everyone! I'm about to shake things!
Let's keep it hot today!

respawn.en: This fire doesn't go out that easy!

skill_q.en: Turret's down! It shoots on its own!

skill_e.en: Trap's set! Go on, step on it!

ult_ally.en: Lava eruption! Don't burn your feet!

ult_enemy.en: Things are getting hot down there!

call_help.en: It's a big fight here! Everyone come!

point_captured.en: Point taken! The ground is on our side!

victory.en: Even the ground is cheering for us!

defeat.en: The embers are still alive. Next round!

staple.name: 스테이플
staple.voice: 사무용 로봇. 평평한 기계음(TTS 로봇 필터 권장), 공손한 '~합니다'체. 모든 걸 사무 업무로 처리한다.

select.en: Staple online. Beginning work.
Filing mode. Enemies will be stapled.

match_start.en: Business hours. Attendance confirmed.
Distributing the operation memo. Please review.

skill_e.en: Wire installed. Approaches will be reported.

ult_ally.text: 강철 봉쇄 승인. 범위 내 적을 철합니다.
ult_ally.en: Steel lockdown approved. Stapling all enemies in range.

ult_enemy.en: Warning. This area is now locked down.

capture_start.en: Entering the point. Beginning occupancy procedure.

point_losing.text: 거점 소유권 이전 중. 저지 바랍니다.

lines.text: 볼더! 이번에도 앞에서 다 받아 줄 거지?
lines.en: Boulder! You'll tank everything up front again, right?
If you don't set anything on fire.
Can't promise that!
I'll cut more than you today.
Your mouth's faster than your blade, kid.

lines.text: 종이 닌자. 오늘은 내 앞을 막지 마라.
lines.en: Paper ninja. Stay out of my way today.
As long as you don't charge ahead first.

lines.text: 오리가미 씨! 오늘도 포장 좀 도와줄 거죠?
lines.en: Miss Origami! You'll help me pack today too, right?
...Paper cranes don't do deliveries.

lines.text: 고양이 처자, 내 두루마리에 먹물 흘리지 마시오.
lines.en: Young cat, do not spill ink on my scroll.
Hmm, it'd look prettier that way.
Gem! I'm a sparkly stone too!
Then let me polish you up, sparkle sparkle~
Grandpa, talismans have no medical basis.
Ho ho, so long as they work.
Cardboard. I will assist with box sealing duties.

lines.text: 오, 스테이플! 오늘도 꽉꽉 찍어 줘요!
lines.en: Oh, Staple! Staple 'em tight today!

lines.text: 또 베이고 오면 이번엔 마취 없이 꿰맨다.
lines.en: Come back cut up again and I stitch you without anesthesia.
...Then I just won't get hurt.
Tin can! Don't overheat!

lines.text: 정정합니다. 깡통이 아니라 사무 자동화 기기입니다.
lines.en: Correction. Not a tin can. An office automation device.
Boulder, don't doze off behind your wall.
...Wasn't sleeping.
Fox, tone down the sparkle. It's blinding.
Cats like sparkly things too~
